mapper.select: select last_event_seq from aden_workspace where workspace_id=#{workspaceId} and workspace_status='ACTIVE'

select task_id taskId,workspace_id workspaceId,task_type taskType,required_capability capabilityCode, title,task_state state,version,error_code reasonCode,created_at createdAt,updated_at updatedAt, correlation_id correlationId from aden_task where workspace_id=#{workspaceId} and task_id=#{taskId}

select step_id stepId,task_id taskId,step_no ordinal,step_state state,attempt_no attemptNo,version, coalesce(cast(json_unquote(json_extract(output_json,'$.progressPercent')) as unsigned),0) progressPercent from aden_task_step where workspace_id=#{workspaceId} and task_id=#{taskId} order by step_no,attempt_no,step_id
select min(event_seq) from aden_event where workspace_id=#{workspaceId}
